# Section ready bits

Bit n-1 is set once section n is loaded and initialised.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0xa26565c0` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Loaded bits are at 0xa26565c4. Section 4 is bit 3, section 9 is 0x100, section 10 is 0x200. Boot guards test these bits.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Bit layout read from the section waiter and the ready test. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Guards that test the bit before jumping into a later section boot reliably. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
